Start at the Louvre, which offers excellent elevator access and plenty of seating for rest breaks. Spend the second day exploring the Seine banks via a gentle river cruise to avoid excessive walking. On the final day, visit the Musée d’Orsay, a compact and accessible option with comfortable viewing areas. Keep daily itineraries loose to ensure your mother stays comfortable and enjoys the historic atmosphere without feeling rushed.
